items.headline: Trump Urges Ukraine to Halt Strikes on Russian Refineries Amid Global Fuel Shortage
items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump publicly urged Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to stop attacking Russian oil refineries, arguing that the strikes are driving a severe global diesel shortage. The request follows record U.S. diesel prices surpassing six dollars a gallon after months of targeted Ukrainian long-range attacks on Russian energy infrastructure.

items.headline: Top AI Leaders Call to Slow Development as Safety Debate Intensifies
items.summary: Leading artificial intelligence executives from Anthropic, OpenAI, and xAI have publicly backed calls to slow down advanced model development so safety frameworks can catch up. The rare alignment among rival tech leaders sparked immediate global discussion, though political figures like U.S. President Donald Trump warned against slowing down and risking international competitiveness.

items.headline: Alexander Zverev Defeats Ben Shelton to Win 2026 US Open Men's Title
items.summary: Top-seeded Alexander Zverev defeated American Ben Shelton in four sets to claim the 2026 US Open men's singles championship at Arthur Ashe Stadium on Sunday. The victory earns the German star his second Grand Slam title of the season following his French Open victory in June.

items.headline: "Woman Unknown" Wins Golden Lion at 83rd Venice Film Festival
items.summary: Danish-Egyptian filmmaker May el-Toukhy's post-World War II drama "Woman Unknown" won the coveted Golden Lion for Best Film as the 83rd Venice International Film Festival concluded. The historic win marks a major moment for female directors in cinema, with lead star Mathilde Arcel also taking home the festival's Best Actress award.
